Textarea element produces readable output

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert, ConversionOptions, PreprocessingOptions

def main() -> None:
    html = "<form><label>Message:</label><textarea>Default text content</textarea></form>"
    options = ConversionOptions(preprocessing=PreprocessingOptions(remove_forms=False))
    result = convert(html, options)
    print(result.content)

main()
```
